newsitem.title: UK: ED&F Man sells cocoa processing unit to ADM.
newsitem.headline: ED&F Man sells cocoa processing unit to ADM.

text.p: British commodity company ED&F Man Group Plc said on Friday it signed a definitive deal to sell its cocoa processing business to U.S. group Archer Daniels Midland Co for $108 million in cash plus the assumption of debt.
ED&F said ADM would discharge intra-group debt of $35 million and assume third-party bank indebtedness of $80 million.
The company's shares shot up around 13 percent, rising 25-1/2 pence to 217-1/2 to rank among the top percentage gainers on the London Stock Exchange by 0740 GMT.
ED&F expected to complete the deal in July or August and initially use proceeds to cut debt.
The cocoa processing business had pre-tax profits of $11.3 million before interest for the year to March 31 and net assets of $35.7 million.
ED&F said it would retain its profitable cocoa sourcing operations and its international cocoa merchanting business.

"The sale of the cocoa processing business is part of our strategy of focusing investment on those activities where we see consistently high levels of return for our shareholders," ED&F said in its statement.
